obsidian.cliHint: Fieldguide uses the official Obsidian CLI to validate vaults, open notes, and search. The CLI requires Obsidian to be running and installer version 1.12.7 or newer.
obsidian.fixTitle: How to enable the Obsidian CLI
obsidian.fix1: Update Obsidian to installer version 1.12.7 or newer
obsidian.fix2: In Obsidian, open "Settings → General", enable "Command line interface", and complete the registration as prompted
obsidian.fix3: Restart your terminal (PATH changes only apply in a new terminal session)
obsidian.fix4: Make sure Obsidian is running, then click "Check again"
obsidian.vaultHint: Choose or create an Obsidian vault. Fieldguide only writes to the "folder name/project" subfolder inside it and never touches your other notes.

obsidian.unbindHint: After unbinding, Fieldguide writes nothing else into this vault. "Clean up generated notes" only deletes files that are still byte-identical to Fieldguide's last write — anything you edited or wrote yourself is kept.

about.title: About Fieldguide
about.description: Turn codebases into explorable, navigable, queryable knowledge maps. Supports paper ↔ code bridging, change impact analysis, and AI-powered code Q&A.
about.uaCredit: Knowledge graph engine built on the Understand Anything project
